pages.text: Sky Frogs is a void skyblock - no ground to mine, no ores, no caves, no stronghold. Frogs are the whole economy: feed a Resource Slime to its matching Frog and it hands back a Froglight you smelt into the resource. Every metal, gem, and drop is just a frog you have not met yet.

The quest book drives progression, tier by tier: Cave, Geode, Bog, Tide, Infernal, then Void. Treat this guide as the reference shelf - the pages here cover the few things specific to this pack, where it bends stock Productive Frogs to fit a world with nothing to dig.
